name: CFBenchmark-MM
description: CFBenchmark-MM is a Chinese multimodal financial benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on financial data involving text, tables, and various chart types. It contains over 9,000 image-question pairs and uses a staged evaluation system to assess models' ability to interpret multimodal financial information.
reputation: A very recent, specialized benchmark from the original paper, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on multimodal financial data including tables and charts; highlights challenges in visual content interpretation and financial concept understanding.
